integrity_notes: All transport plans and dual witnesses are explicit for the claimed metric and mass normalization.
The earlier bipartite formula and the known total-variation contraction threshold are compared as prior mathematical coverage, not asserted as new.
Only self-review has been performed; neither independent audit nor publication priority is certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unweighted complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and their combinatorial Laplacian only.
The metric is the original graph shortest-path metric and the only transport exponent is W1.
The time-zero exact identities extend to all times by a separate analytic proof; finite rational test runs alone are not proofs for arbitrary real times.
title: Exact heat-kernel transport on complete multipartite graphs
